claims.value: Dirac SM-singlet psi and complex SM-singlet phi share Dmu=partial+i eprime V, hence unit hidden charge in the same explicit source coordinate. SM fields hidden neutral; phi Higgses U1prime. V is its gauge connection, not additional matter. Dirac psi expands into two LH conjugate rows.

Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated.
